auditor.name: D H A & Co., Practicing Chartered Accountants, Delhi
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding legal dispute over land held as Fixed Assets (plots E-18, E-19, E-29, E-30 at Chikalthana Industrial Area, Maharashtra) where MIDC revoked lease rights; Company filed writ petition, Court permitted only symbolic possession; land valued at Rs 20.02 crore; management confident of favourable outcome, no adjustment made.
